reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch Re-Harden (mat_g1_na_q2_2), 2026-08-18

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The sample packet directly fulfills every component of the MATATAG learning competency ('Determine the place value of a digit in a 2-digit number, the value of a digit, and the digit of a number, given its place value.'). Identifying digits given a place value is tested in questions like "In 10, what digit is in the ones place?" (seed 42) and "In 76, what digit is in the tens place?" (seed 501). Identifying the place of a digit is assessed in "What place is the digit 5 in, in the number 15?" (seed 43) and "What place is the digit 0 in, in the number 20?" (seed 46). Determining the value of a digit is assessed in "What is the place value of the digit 2 in 20?" (seed 45), "What is the place value of the digit 1 in 15?" (seed 600), and "In the number 50, the value of the digit 5 in the tens place is 500. True or False?" (seed 50).

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The sample set comprehensively covers both the tens and ones places across various 2-digit numbers, ranging from smaller teen numbers and round multiples of 10 to higher arbitrary numbers (e.g., 10, 12, 15, 20, 40, 45, 50, 76, 85, 97). Queries test both ones and tens positions thoroughly across items such as "In 85, what digit is in the ones place?" (seed 502) and "In the number 97, the value of the digit 9 in the tens place is 97. True or False?" (seed 500).

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The language and question syntax are appropriately concise and clear for Grade 1 Quarter 2 learners. Sentences are short and unambiguous (e.g., "What is the place value of the digit 1 in 12?" and "In 10, what digit is in the ones place?"), presenting no unnecessary reading comprehension burden while isolating the mathematical concept.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The packet showcases multiple formatters: Multiple Choice Questions (mcq, e.g. seed 42 "In 10, what digit is in the ones place?", seed 44 "What is the place value of the digit 0 in 40?"), Fill-in / Cloze (cloze, e.g. seed 43 "What place is the digit 5 in, in the number 15?", seed 501 "In 76, what digit is in the tens place?"), and True/False assertions with both true and false truth values (true_false, e.g. seed 601 "What place is the digit 5 in, in the number 45? The answer is ones. True or False?" and seed 50 "In the number 50, the value of the digit 5 in the tens place is 500. True or False?").

competency_alignment.rationale: All generated items align precisely with the curriculum specifications without introducing out-of-scope concepts (such as 3-digit numbers, expanded notation arithmetic, or fractions/decimals). Questions strictly require determining the place, the digit value, or the digit itself in 2-digit numbers as seen in "In 85, what digit is in the ones place?" (seed 502) and "What is the place value of the digit 0 in 40?" (seed 44).

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The numerical scale is strictly bounded to 2-digit numbers (10 through 97), including essential boundary cases such as 0 in the ones place (seeds 42, 44, 45, 46, 50) and larger 2-digit numbers (seeds 500, 501, 502) with appropriate place value distractors (e.g., seed 50 evaluating value 500 vs 50, seed 500 evaluating value 97 vs 90).
